name: reachability
author: 7780ae37
description: Checks whether any path exists from a source node to a target node, using breadth-first search. Use it for yes/no connectivity questions such as 'can you get from X to Y at all?', 'is A connected to B?' or 'can course A lead to course B?'. Works on directed graphs (follows edge direction, so A reaching B does not imply B reaching A) and undirected graphs. Returns reachable (true/false), the number of hops, and one fewest-hop path as a list of nodes with ids and labels.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse, e.g. 'airports', 'karate' or 'courses'.

source.description: Node id where the path starts (use lookup_node to find ids from names).

target.description: Node id where the path should end (use lookup_node to find ids from names).
